correctness.rationale: For each p^a||n, if m>p^a the published support lemma excludes p. Otherwise Kummer carries on levels b<j<=a and a+L<j<=a+b uniformly give a-L. Choosing q=2 for m=1 or q=1+t p^a otherwise, Legendre digit sums show v_p binom(qk,k)=a-v_p binom(m-1,t); t=p^L-1 creates exactly L carries, furnishing equality. Published Lemma 4 eliminates p not dividing n. Checked all boundaries and the witness restriction q<=n; finite exact arithmetic corroborates.

value.rationale: Provides the full exact natural gcd and exact optimizing multiplier for each local prime factor of n, strengthening a recent published yes/no gcd criterion. This is an exact number-theoretic invariant with intrinsic arithmetic motivation, not a selected numerical slice; the nontrivial two-zone carry lower bound and digit-block witness derive multiplicities not logically implied by support-only results.
